subject: dsa
title: Find Minimum in Rotated Sorted Array
summary: Compare the middle to the right end. If mid is larger, the wrap-around low lies to its right; otherwise the minimum is at mid or to its left. Halve the range each step.
problem: A sorted array was rotated at some pivot. Find its minimum element in O(log n).

steps.caption: This sorted array was rotated, so it climbs then wraps down to a low. Find the minimum in O(log n): it sits right where the order breaks.
Search [0..6]. The trick: compare the middle to the right end. If mid > right end, the wrap (and the min) lies to mid's right.
mid = index 3 (value 7). 7 > right end 2, so the minimum is to the right. Move lo past mid.
mid = index 5 (value 1). 1 < right end 2, so the min is at mid or to its left. Move hi to mid.
mid = index 4 (value 0). 0 < right end 1, so the min is at mid or left. Move hi to mid.
lo and hi meet at index 4. The minimum is 0.
